section: Checks: Database, Framework, Library, Platform, Tool, and the Registry
finding: | `library/drizzle.ts:20-50` `relations` | The check runs per file (the manifest sets no `runs`, so the default `files` applies). In a commit hook, `input.files` holds only the staged `.ts` files. A table in a staged `schema.ts` whose `relations()` call lives in an unstaged `relations.ts` is reported, although the doc says "anywhere in the scope". Drizzle 1.0's `defineRelations()` declares relations without `relations(table` (verify against the pinned version). | Set `runs = "scope"` in `kits/library/drizzle/manifest.toml` so the check reads every `.ts` file. Or delete the check, since relations are optional in Drizzle. |

verification.remains: In `packages/cli/configurations/library/drizzle/manifest.toml:36-46`, set `runs = "scope"` on `drizzle/relations`. The built-in check then reads the `relations()` calls in every `.ts` file of the scope, not only the staged files of a commit hook. Keep the check. Accepting `defineRelations` and correcting the why are in `slices/kits-frameworks-tools/021`.

section: Checks: Database, Framework, Library, Platform, Tool, and the Registry

Otherwise use the constants. Rename it `snapshotFiles`. |

verification.remains: In `packages/cli/src/checks/library/drizzle.ts:12-15`, build the excluded folders from `SCRATCH_DIRECTORIES` (`packages/cli/src/config/execution/snapshot.ts:11`) and `DOT_GSPOT` (`packages/cli/src/config/platform/locations.ts:28`) instead of the literals `node_modules`, `.venv`, and `.gspot`. Rename `generatedContents` to `copiedFiles`.

section: Checks: Database, Framework, Library, Platform, Tool, and the Registry
finding: | `tool/docker/dockerignore.ts:20-21` `dockerignore` | Looks for `.dockerignore` only beside each Dockerfile. BuildKit first reads `<Dockerfile name>.dockerignore` beside the Dockerfile, and otherwise `.dockerignore` at the build context root, which compose `build.context` often puts elsewhere. Both layouts get a false `missing-file`. | Accept `<name>.dockerignore`. Read the context from the compose files, or report only when no ignore file applies. |

verification.remains: In `packages/cli/src/checks/tool/docker.ts:79-90`, accept `<Dockerfile name>.dockerignore` beside the Dockerfile, and `.dockerignore` at the build context root that a Compose file's `build.context` names. Report `missing-file` only when none of these files exists.

section: Checks: Database, Framework, Library, Platform, Tool, and the Registry
finding: | `tool/docker/trivy-image.ts:83-113` `trivyImage`, `scanImage` | Secrets that Trivy finds are reported under the rule `vulnerability`. The message keeps the first 20 items (`SHOWN_FINDINGS`) and does not say that more were dropped. An image named in two compose files is scanned twice. | Use the rule `secret` for secrets. Append "and N more". Scan each image once and report it on each file. |

verification.evidence: `packages/cli/src/checks/tool/docker.ts:62,117-128` puts secrets under rule `vulnerability`, cuts at `SHOWN_FINDINGS` without "and N more", and scans once per Compose file
verification.remains: In `packages/cli/src/checks/tool/docker.ts`, report Trivy secret results under a new rule `secret` instead of `vulnerability` (`:62`). When a message cuts the list at `SHOWN_FINDINGS` (`:117-128`), append "and N more". Scan each image name once per run and report its results on every Compose file that names it.
